description.en: Focused on injecting unexpected moments of joy into brand experiences
description.zh: 专注于在品牌体验中注入意想不到的愉悦时刻

welcome_message.en: Our product has complete features but the user experience lacks delight and user satisfaction needs improvement. Please, Delightful Experience Designer, help me create delightful user interaction experiences.
welcome_message.zh: 我们的产品功能完备但用户体验不够惊艳,用户满意度有待提升,请愉悦体验设计师帮我创造令人愉悦的用户交互体验。
